# About SpotDraft

![Large group of people posing on stage in white shirts in front of a blue screen displaying the SpotDraft logo.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a7437ea684517/669a3bdab7abc7792581a11f_%5BADD%20IMAGE%5D%20(1).webp)

## From 2017 to the Future:

### Enabling Organizations Globally to Streamline Contract Management

SpotDraft is an end-to-end contract automation platform for cutting-edge companies. SpotDraft’s AI powered contract lifecycle management system handles everything contract-related for the entirety of the contract lifecycle, including third party paper, clickwrap agreements, AI-assisted redlining, e-signatures, and an intelligent contract repository. We are currently expanding our footprint worldwide with big brands.

## We started SpotDraft because…

It was 2017. Self-driving cars were becoming a reality, yet Shashank, our CEO, working at a law firm, found himself endlessly copy-pasting words on contracts. He recognized a critical gap in the legal industry—while technology was advancing rapidly in other sectors, contract management remained archaic.

This absurdity sparked a vision for change. Shashank joined forces with Madhav from Carnegie Mellon, to revolutionize contract management. Their diverse backgrounds converged on a single mission: to free legal teams from mundane tasks and unlock their true potential.

CEO and Co-Founder

After studying law at Harvard, Shashank joined White & Case, New York, as an attorney. The years of practicing corporate law gave him a good understanding of the everyday challenges lawyers face and also honed his entrepreneurial insights. As CEO of SpotDraft, Shashank integrates his legal expertise with global insights to solve problems that are most pertinent for today’s legal teams. An avid reader, Shashank is an active member of multiple legal communities.

## Shreya Gupta

VP, Strategy

Shreya Gupta is Vice President of Strategy at SpotDraft, where she drives strategic initiatives that accelerate the company's growth and expansion. She leads the Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model for new business initiatives, taking ideas from concept to execution before transitioning them into scalable, long-term functions. Combining strategic thinking with operational rigor, Shreya works across teams to identify growth opportunities, build repeatable processes, and enable successful market execution. An alumna of the Indian School of Business, she brings a strong blend of business strategy, execution excellence, and cross-functional leadership to help SpotDraft scale as a category-defining AI-powered contract lifecycle management company.

Shreya Gupta is a strategy leader at SpotDraft, passionate about driving growth and enabling organizational success. With experience across strategy, business operations, and transformation initiatives, she focuses on solving complex challenges and building scalable processes. An alumna of the Indian School of Business, Shreya is driven by continuous learning and creating meaningful impact.

CIO, Gunderson Dettmer

Joe Green is the Chief Innovation Officer at Gunderson Dettmer, the preeminent international law firm with an exclusive focus on the innovation economy. Joe is also a Co-founder and Director of the Open Cap Table Coalition, a Fund Advisor to the LegalTech Fund, and advises a number of legal tech companies. He has taught courses at Central Michigan University and Columbia University, and he spent four years at Thomson Reuters working on Practical Law. He started his career at Gunderson Dettmer and Simpson Thacher & Bartlett.
